resources.string: Custom tones, LED, shutter sound and wake word
Pick an audio file for any sound you want to replace. Leave the others as they are. The glasses hold only short sounds, so longer sounds are shortened to fit.
Wear the glasses. Each sample records about 3 seconds through the glasses microphone. Say the phrase once per sample, in a quiet room, the way you will use it.

I agree that my recordings and files are uploaded to build this firmware and are deleted after the build is emailed or the request is declined. If CyanBridge does not yet hold my glasses\' firmware version, I agree that it may review the request and build on the same or a newer official firmware version for my model; installing the custom firmware then updates my glasses to that version. While a version is reviewed my recordings are kept for at most 30 days (consent version %1$s). I install the firmware at my own risk.
After the email arrives, save its attachment and install it here.
